system.description:
A divine spark landed in your bloodline: not cleanly, not intentionally. The gods do not always aim well.

  • Bloodline Cantrips: Sacred Flame and First Aid.
  • Bloodline Ability (1st): Once per day, channel divine energy into one spell: it deals radiant damage instead of its normal type, and creatures that fail their save against it are Blinded until the end of your next turn.
  • Advantage on saves against spells cast by Clerics, Paladins and celestials.
  • As a 10-minute ritual, lay hands on a creature: it has Advantage on its next save against one disease or poison affecting it.
  • Advantage on Wisdom checks involving divine lore or identifying holy and unholy sites.
  • Bloodline Awakening (10th): Once per day, for 1 minute your spells cannot be counterspelled or dispelled, and any Wild Surge you use during this window carries no Corruption risk. At the end, recover one expended spell slot of 5th level or lower.
